cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at two tertiary hospitals in Harare, Zimbabwe between March-August 2019 (n=11,346) and March-August 2020 (n=8,489).
finding: Compared to 2019, there was a significant increase in breech deliveries, uterine ruptures, stillbirths, and neonatal deaths in 2020, but a decrease in caesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: There was a significant increase in breech deliveries in 2020 compared to 2019 (OR=1.2; 95% CI=1.1-1.5), and a decrease in caesarean sections (OR=0.7; 95% CI=0.7-0.8).
